Results.ReviewText: The ventilation of this system is unsurpassed. Excellent in temp control excellent in flame control , I truly love the grill. I have been cooking on webers for forty years, and this is there best for the money.
Results.Title: Smokehouse Dawg of the Ga Dawgpack.

Results.ReviewText:
1) The cover hook should move 90 degrees and become perpendicular with the hand, would be much easier to hand the cover on the side.
2) The thermometer should be under the vents on the same side. It's doesn't make any sense when it's over the coals when the meat is under the vents, you want to know the temp on the meat side, not over burning coals.
3) make the entire grill higher, it's very low, like it's made for 5,5 people.
Or at least sell longer legs, and don't make then an inch taller, make them at least 5 inches taller.
Other than that, the grill is really good and I'm happy with my purchase
Results.Title: How to make it PERFECT

Results.ReviewText: This is my 2nd weber kettle. The first one was close to 30 years old and though it was still functional I decided it was time for a new model. The old one was a one touch also, but there have been a few design upgrades over the years. I love my new one. I use a big barrel grill also for occasions when I need a really large cooking area, but the Weber kettle is my goto for most occasions.
Results.Title: The Weber kettle is my goto grill

Results.ReviewText: I've been grilling as often as possible because I love using this grill! Very easy to control temp and everything I've put on the grill cooks evenly compared to my previous barrel charcoal grill. Ash and debris is very easy to clean, highly recommend this classic grill.
Results.Title: A must have

Results.ReviewText:
Worst grill ever, and I have used Weber grills for 40 years.  Using an even bed of charcoal for direct grilling, only half of the grill area got hot enough to sear the food.

The customer support person did not know the product, left me on hold for over 20 minutes, and did not resolve my issue.
Results.Title: Worst grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is well made, grilled evenly, and looks great with its copper finish. Assembly was clear and easy, except the legs. I wound up just relying on good old "gravity " to secure them since the button snaps kept sliding into the leg when i tried to line up the snap with the predrilled holes. I don't plan on moving the grill any distance so i believe i will again have many years of great grilling and Bar-B-Qing. This is 3rd Webber Kettle in 40 years (and one  i out grew because it was just too small).
Results.Title: Would be 5 stars except to legs

Results.ReviewText: You just can't beat a Weber kettle grill for general all-round grilling. With charcoal trays added, you can control the temperature just like your oven

Results.ReviewText: So far, I've been a bit disappointed in the 22" kettle grill.  I am having a hard time getting it hot enough, even for cooking a small amount of food.  I keep the dampers wide open, and use a chimney starter.  I have tried using charcoal, not briquets.  I don't know whether I am not suing enough fuel, but so far, it has been hard to get the grill up to even 350 degrees with fully heated charcoal

Results.ReviewText: Simple, quick to heat up and control. A much more affordable option that kamado style grills. Perfect for when I come home just want grill something quickly.

We appreciate your feedback. We are very sorry to hear about the carbonized grease in your lid. We are here to help. 

That "peeling paint" is just a build-up of carbonized grease. To clean it off, simply take a brush or ball of aluminum foil and gently scrape the grease off the lid. For more information click here: http://Wbr.gr/paintpeeling.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is so simple BUT produces the very best quality.  Using the Weber Chimney to fire up the charcoal, the original premium kettle produces an even, hot grilling experience and the results are delicious!  Highly recommended.

Assembly isn't easy. 
Legs don't fit smoothly at all. 
The damper in the mid needs a non heating handle. Gets too hot to rotate during cooking.
Results.Title: Assembly and lid damper

Results.ReviewText: I purchased one about two years ago for my summer home. I liked it so much I replaced the one at my residence with a duplicate. Easy to use.
Results.Title: Liked it so much

Results.ReviewText:
I've had several of these over the years and they have all been great! I highly recommend these if you want "real BBQ" instead of gas grilling. Steaks BBQ'ed over charcoal always tastes better than "grilling them" over gas. It does take more time to prepare to cook but it's well worth the extra effort.
Use a charcoal chimney to light the charcoal as "Match Light" briquets will put "taste" in what you are cooking. If you want to take BBQing seriously as I do and be a purist use lump charcoal in lieu of briquets because briquets have additives in them to make their shape and hold together. Briquets burn longer and leave more ash while lump charcoal is pure, leaves less ash and burns hotter which is great for searing steaks. You may want to use briquets for a long cook. I keep both on hand!
Results.Title: These have always been great grills

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
